name: Anping Boen Metal Products Co., Ltd.
nameZh: 安平博恩金属制品有限公司
description: Anping Boen Metal Products specializes in press-locked and welded steel bar grating for industrial flooring, platforms, and drainage covers. Plain and serrated bearing bars from 20×3 mm to 100×8 mm, panels up to 2000×6000 mm. Hot-dip galvanizing in-house.
descriptionZh: 安平博恩金属制品专业生产压焊式和熔焊式钢格栅，用于工业地板、操作平台和排水沟盖板。扁钢规格从20×3 mm至100×8 mm，面板最大2000×6000 mm，自有热镀锌生产线。

name: Hebei Juneng Industrial Grating Co., Ltd.
nameZh: 河北聚能工业格栅有限公司
description: Hebei Juneng Industrial Grating focuses on heavy-duty welded steel grating for petrochemical platforms, power plants, and road trench covers. Bearing bars from 30×3 mm to 120×12 mm. Specializes in non-standard panel sizes and load-rated grating per NAAMM MBG 531.
descriptionZh: 河北聚能工业格栅专注于重型压焊钢格栅，适用于石油化工平台、发电厂和道路排水沟盖板。扁钢规格从30×3 mm至120×12 mm，擅长非标尺寸定制，符合NAAMM MBG 531荷载等级要求。

name: Anping Huilong Stainless Steel Products Co., Ltd.
nameZh: 安平惠隆不锈钢制品有限公司
description: Anping Huilong specializes in stainless steel bar grating (SS304 and SS316L) and aluminum bar grating for food processing, pharmaceutical, offshore, and architectural applications. Material certifications (EN 10204 3.1) available. Bearing bars from 20×2 mm to 65×5 mm.
descriptionZh: 安平惠隆专业生产不锈钢格栅（304/316L）和铝合金格栅，适用于食品加工、制药、海洋和建筑装饰场合。可提供EN 10204 3.1材质证书，扁钢规格从20×2 mm至65×5 mm。

name: Anping Chunkun Metal Products Co., Ltd.
nameZh: 安平纯坤金属制品有限公司
description: Anping Chunkun Metal Products focuses on grating stair treads and serrated anti-slip steel grating for construction, offshore rigs, and industrial walkways. Nosing plates in welded flat bar or angle iron. Serrated bearing bars for enhanced grip in wet environments. Bearing bars from 25×3 mm to 75×6 mm.
descriptionZh: 安平纯坤金属制品专注于格栅踏步板和锯齿型防滑钢格栅，适用于建筑、海洋平台和工业走道。踏步板提供扁钢和角钢封边，锯齿型扁钢适用于潮湿环境防滑，扁钢规格从25×3 mm至75×6 mm。
